verdict.rationale: Cline exposes MCP server management and granular Auto-Approve settings (including per-tool-type approval for file changes, terminal, browser, MCP tools) that let a user restrict which external tools/integrations the agent can invoke, and the CLI/hub lets you 'manage models, plugins, and MCP servers.' However, evidence is all individual/workspace-level configuration rather than a team-wide policy or admin console an engineering-lead could enforce across a team. Missing for 10: org-level/admin enforcement of tool permissions, audit/logging of tool access decisions, and independent confirmation that these controls hold up in practice.
